rationale: The plan correctly specifies ~batch + condition with explicit reference level and named contrast, matches the balanced two-batch design, and explicitly avoids pre-model count adjustment (no ComBat-seq before the test). QC uses blind VST/PCA/distance heatmap colored by both condition and batch, with library-size and outlier policy stated. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified by group size. DESeq2 Wald test, BH at alpha 0.05, apeglm shrinkage with both shrunken/unshrunken LFC reported, and independent filtering are all explicit. Enrichment correctly uses tested-gene universe, named/versioned collections, size window, separate BH per collection, and a stated fallback to preranked fgsea with rank metric specified. The report section enumerates versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and design caveats (3 per cell, Cook's NA flags) comprehensively.
